keyVerseText: And the heaven departed as a scroll when it is rolled together; and every mountain and island were moved out of their places.
rootMeaning: The word εἱλίσσω (heilíssō) is a prolonged form of the primary but defective verb εἵλω (heílō), which carries the core meaning of rolling or coiling together. This root sense emphasizes a physical action of wrapping or turning around, suggesting a dynamic process of drawing elements into a compact or organized form. Beyond the English gloss of simply 'roll together,' the root conveys a deliberate, controlled motion of enfolding or encircling, which enriches the imagery of things being brought into a new shape or state.
usageInScripture: This verb appears only once in Scripture, specifically in Revelation 6:14, where it is translated as 'when it is rolled together.' The singular occurrence limits the range of usage but highlights the vividness of the image — the heavens depart as a scroll that is rolled up, emphasizing transformation and movement. The consistent translation of the verb as an act of rolling or coiling underscores its literal and metaphorical power to depict significant cosmic upheaval.
theologicalSignificance: Understanding εἱλίσσω as a word meaning to roll or coil together enriches our grasp of divine sovereignty and eschatological transformation. The imagery of rolling up the heavens like a scroll points to God's authority over creation, demonstrating that the cosmos itself is subject to His unfolding plan. This verb reminds believers that God's purposes involve not just static existence but dynamic, purposeful change that culminates in the fulfillment of His kingdom. It encourages trust in God's control over all things, even when the natural order appears to be unmade or reformed.
keyVerseReflection: Revelation 6:14 describes the heavens departing 'as a scroll when it is rolled together,' using εἱλίσσω to convey the action of the heavens being compacted or withdrawn like a scroll being rolled up. This vivid metaphor highlights the dramatic and complete nature of the cosmic judgment unfolding. The verb's meaning intensifies the sense of finality and divine intervention, illustrating that the very fabric of creation is being reshaped according to God's sovereign will.
